title: Raiders work out 16 players, including OL Evan Neal, WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Raiders work out 16 players, including OL Evan Neal, WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling
sources.description: The Raiders worked out 16 players on Thursday, and the group of tryout players included offensive lineman Evan Neal and wide receiver Marquez Valdes-Scantling.
